before-grim-tales.npc: What you want, little human? Grimgnash hungry. Want tasty morsel like you!

before-grim-tales.player: Like me? Why? Who are you?

before-grim-tales.npc: I Grimgnash and I hungry! Perhaps I eat you!

before-grim-tales.player: I'm really not that tasty. I think I should be going now. Goodbye.

before-grim-tales.npc: Human lucky Grimgnash too tired to hunt for food. Stupid wolves keep Grimgnash awake with howling. Grimgnash can't sleep.

before-grim-tales-using-an-item-on-grimg.npc: Grargk! Grimgnash not care for stupid human things! Grimgnash hungry!

before-grim-tales-using-an-item-on-grimg.text: (Grimgnash attacks the player, and does a large amount of damage.)
Grimgnash lashes out at you and you recoil backwards in pain. You must be more careful what you say. Grimgnash could eat you at any moment!

before-grim-tales-trying-to-take-from-th.npc: Grahh! What human doing? Why human here? Grimgnash hungry!

before-grim-tales-trying-to-take-from-th.player: Uh...er...sorry! I didn't mean to disturb you. I'll just be going now.

before-grim-tales-trying-to-take-from-th.text: You won't be able to take a feather while the griffin is watching.

before-grim-tales-trying-to-talk-to-grim.text: You can't seem to get the griffin's attention from here.

after-grim-tales.text: Grimgnash looks like he's sleeping nicely. It would probably be dangerous to your health to try and wake him up now!
